channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: County begins independent audit after ex-con COO charged with embezzlement
item.description: The county is formally reviewing its internal contracting processes following embezzlement charges against a nonprofit executive.

item.title: Above-average heat to grip San Diego County through Friday
item.description: High pressure aloft will keep temperatures well above seasonal averages across San Diego County Tuesday and continuing through Friday.

item.title: Is Kaiser’s labor-management model unraveling?
item.description: Health care workers say the system’s push for growth is undermining a once-vaunted partnership — and affecting patients.

item.title: California's immigrant families fear losing benefits amid public charge confusion
item.description: Officials can deny green card and visa applications if they determine the applicant is likely to rely heavily on government assistance.

item.title: TJ Maxx and Ulta Beauty bring new shopping options to La Mesa
item.description: Defying a trend of stores closing elsewhere, TJ Maxx and Ulta Beauty both opened for business this month at Grossmont Center.

item.title: WhatsApp:03.24.26. Si trabajas cortando piedra artificial, cuidado
item.description: Retrasos en el aeropuerto de San Diego, riesgos por cortar piedra artificial, nuevos proyectos en Tijuana y más noticias relevantes para la frontera.

item.title: Five questions with Lonesome Roses: Songwriting duo goes unamplified in Encinitas
item.description: Their monthly series at Fox Point Farms in Encinitas starts again Thursday, but Lonesome Roses also keeps busy writing music for television.

item.title: California governor debate canceled after criticism from candidates of color, lawmakers
item.description: Two Republicans and four Democrats, all white, had been set to participate in the debate, which left out four candidates of color.

item.title: Former City Councilman challenges promises tied to 'Empty Homes Tax'
item.description: Former San Diego City Councilman Scott Sherman has filed a legal challenge to the ballot materials for the city's "Empty Homes Tax" measure.

item.title: San Diego to begin delivering new recycling bins Wednesday through early fall
item.description: San Diego will begin delivering light blue recycling bins to households that receive city trash and recycling service Wednesday.

item.title: El Cajon native who died rescuing two boys from Arizona river awarded Carnegie Medal
item.description: An El Cajon native who died rescuing two children from an Arizona river will be posthumously awarded the Carnegie Medal.

item.title: Junior Seau's nephew granted mental health diversion in fatal fentanyl sale case
item.description: Junior Seau's nephew, who initially faced a murder charge in connection with a fatal fentanyl sale, has been granted mental health diversion.

item.title: Retrasos y cancelaciones en el aeropuerto de San Diego
item.description: Largas filas, ausentismo en la TSA y alertas nacionales provocan retrasos y cancelaciones en el Aeropuerto de San Diego.

item.title: Padres hope new concession offerings, giveaways, and more are a hit with the fans
item.description: The new season is just around the corner as the Padres kick off regular-season action on Thursday afternoon versus the Detroit Tigers.

item.title: California is spending hundreds of millions on heat; will it ever be a public health priority?
item.description: Temperatures soared to more than 100 degrees in some parts of the state this week — and it’s still only March.
